Once your child’s place has been confirmed, a non-refundable registration fee of £100.00 will be required to secure their place until they start with us. Eligibility may vary, so please speak with the Nursery Manager at your preferred setting for guidance on the funding options available to you. [location: https://www.millieshouse.net/location/cambridge-avenue-new-malden] Home About Us Locations Cambridge Avenue Chelsea Waterfront Fulham Reach Fulham Palace Parsons Green Putney Westminster Woodlands Avenue Our Childcare Curriculum Daily Life Key Person Nutrition Outdoor Learning Parent Partnership Careers Fees & Registration News Contact Us Cambridge Avenue, New Malden 1a Cambridge Avenue New Malden Surrey KT3 4JY Tel: 020 8942 8195 cambridgeavenue@millieshouse.net  Download Report Download our Ofsted Report Millie’s House Nursery & Pre-School at Cambridge Avenue is a 92-place nursery for children aged three months to five years old. Conveniently situated just off the local high street and a short walk from New Malden train station, the nursery offers a welcoming location for families. Set across two bright, spacious floors, the nursery features four purpose-designed rooms and three separate age-appropriate garden areas. Our youngest children start in the Discoverers Room (up to 18 months), located on the ground floor with its own separate sleep room and direct garden access. They then move into the Explorers Room (up to two years), also on the ground floor, where they can continue to enjoy easy access to outdoor play. Upstairs, children advance to the Inventors Room (two to three years) and finally to Little Einsteins (three to five years) where they gain the confidence and skills to prepare for school. Each of our rooms is thoughtfully designed to be spacious and stimulating, allowing for clearly defined learning zones that reflect the seven areas of development within the Early Years Foundation Stage (EYFS) framework. Our management team Sheila Lanning, Nursery Manager Sheila first joined Millie’s House in 2009 and holds a qualification in Childcare and Education.
